concepts.title: Triangulation of a geometric simplex
concepts.description: A triangulation of S is a finite collection of simplices covering S, closed under faces, such that any two members intersect in a common face or not at all.

concepts.title: Sperner labeling of a triangulated simplex
concepts.description: For S=conv(v₀,…,vₙ), label each triangulation vertex by an element of {0,…,n}; a vertex on conv(vᵢ:i∈I) must have a label in I.

concepts.title: Sperner's lemma
concepts.description: Every Sperner-labeled triangulation of an n-simplex has an odd number of elementary n-simplices carrying all n+1 labels. In particular there is at least one.
